[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Per Google own data center location pages (datacenters.google), Google publishes aggregate state level investment figures for its data center campuses but does not publish exact street addresses, square footage, or MW power capacity for individual buildings on these pages. This is treated as the operators de facto disclosure policy for this registry rather than an unresearched gap; a state or regional level investment figure, where available, is recorded separately as regional_context.
profile.regional_context: Bridgeport is a small town in northeastern Alabama near the Tennessee River; Google's presence there is confirmed directly by the company's own site, with additional confirmation from third party listings (Baxtel, datacenters.com).
profile.disclosure_policy: Google publishes aggregate state level investment figures on its data center location pages but does not publish exact addresses, square footage, or MW capacity for individual buildings
